parsed_response.rationale: Reconstruction omits mobile notifications for delivery updates; focuses on email tracking.

The current low-level goals (LLGs) comprehensively cover the parent high-level goal (HLG) of providing a seamless online shopping and payment experience. Each LLG accurately represents a documented functional interaction or effect that realizes the HLG. The LLGs include browsing the product catalog, adding items to the cart, automatic calculation of order totals, selecting and completing a payment method, generating and sending delivery tracking links via email, and sending mobile notifications for delivery updates. These actions are all document-supported automatic effects that do not require manual triggers by the customer actor.

The LLGs are non-redundant, with each representing a distinct aspect of the online shopping process. There are no missing essential capabilities or unsupported/misleading LLG IDs in this decomposition.

Decision: KEEP_LOW_LEVEL_GOALS
